observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera on top of its original box. The box is labeled 'Nikon D5200 18-55 VR II Kit' with 'BLACK' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II' printed on it.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the camera body. The 'Nikon' logo is visible on the top left, and the model 'D5200' is engraved on the front near the lens mount.
The camera body appears dusty and used, with visible wear on the grip and buttons.
The lens cap is on the lens, and the lens appears to be the 18-55mm kit lens, matching the box description.
The box is visibly damaged, with torn edges and a missing top flap.
